seriesDesc.violin: Handcrafted violins from 4/4 to 1/2. Spruce tops, maple backs, voiced one by one.

seriesDesc.bass: The foundation of the orchestra. Large handcrafted double basses, from soloist to orchestral grade.

seriesDesc.bass: La base de l'orchestre. Contrebasses artisanales, de soliste à orchestre.
